title: AI Discovery Radar — adoption measurements for machine-readable discovery and consent routes
description: Monthly measurements of how many websites in a frozen, stratified sample (Tranco + Chrome UX Report country lists) publish machine-readable discovery and consent files (robots.txt, llms.txt, TDMRep, agent-card.json and others). Shares over observed hosts only, Wilson 95% intervals; full ruleset with version history in RULESET.md. Data files carry run identifier and ruleset version; numbers across ruleset versions are not comparable.
